kapak.alt: Telling the test tone from tinnitus

youtube.baslik: How does someone with tinnitus tell the test tone from the ringing? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: An audiometer can present the test tone as continuous or pulsed; a pulsed tone switches on and off several times per second. Pulsed tones make the sound easier to notice for many patients and help those with tinnitus tell the test tone from their ringing.

cumleler: An audiometer can present the test tone as continuous or pulsed.
A pulsed tone switches on and off several times per second.
Pulsed tones make the sound easier to notice for many patients.
For patients with tinnitus, they help separate the test tone from ringing.
Both are used; what matters is staying consistent with the same patient.
